heading: Lurking house-trespass by night.
text: Whoever commits lurking house-trespass after sunset and before sunrise, is said to commit “lurking house-trespass by night”.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
